connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [VirtualMetric DataStream](https://docs.virtualmetric.com/) Push connector Pushes CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, Event, Syslog, and WindowsEvent telemetry. SecurityEvent | where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream'
Event | where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream'
Syslog | where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream'
WindowsEvent | where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream'

| extend SourceTable = 'SecurityEvent'

| union (Event

| union (Syslog

| where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream')
| union (WindowsEvent

| where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream')

customs.name: VirtualMetric DataStream Agent
customs.description: A running [VirtualMetric DataStream](https://docs.virtualmetric.com/) agent is required to collect, normalize, and push events to the Microsoft Sentinel Logs Ingestion API.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy connector resources
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables the VirtualMetric DataStream agent to push events directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. No manual app registration or DCR setup is required.

parameters.content:
Clicking **Deploy** will create:
- A Data Collection Rule (DCR) with 5 stream(s) routing to the built-in Microsoft Sentinel tables (CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, Event, Syslog, WindowsEvent)
- A Data Collection Endpoint (DCE)
- A Microsoft Entra application with OAuth client credentials
- The Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment for that application on the DCR

No custom tables are created — events land in the built-in tables, so existing analytics rules, workbooks, and parsers continue to work unchanged.

parameters.label: Deploy connector resources
parameters.applicationDisplayName: VirtualMetric DataStream Microsoft Sentinel Standard Push Connector

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure the VirtualMetric DataStream agent
instructionSteps.description: After the deployment completes, copy the values below into your VirtualMetric DataStream agent configuration. The DataStream agent uses these to authenticate with Microsoft Entra and push events to the Data Collection Endpoint.

parameters.label: Application (Client) ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.label: Client Secret (only shown once)
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.label: Data Collection Endpoint Logs Ingestion URI
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.label: Data Collection Rule Immutable ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.content:
Configure these stream names in the VirtualMetric DataStream agent so each event type is routed to the matching table:

- `Custom-CommonSecurityLog`
- `Custom-SecurityEvent`
- `Custom-Event`
- `Custom-Syslog`
- `Custom-WindowsEvent`

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify ingestion
instructionSteps.description: After enabling the integration in the VirtualMetric DataStream agent, allow 5-10 minutes for the first events to appear, then run the sample queries above. If no data appears, verify the DataStream agent has reachability to the Data Collection Endpoint and that the Entra application credentials match.

customs.name: VirtualMetric DataStream Agent
customs.description: A running [VirtualMetric DataStream](https://docs.virtualmetric.com/) agent is required to collect, normalize, and push events to the Microsoft Sentinel Logs Ingestion API.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy connector resources
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables the VirtualMetric DataStream agent to push events directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. No manual app registration or DCR setup is required.

parameters.content:
Clicking **Deploy** will create:
- A Data Collection Rule (DCR) with 10 stream(s) routing to the built-in Microsoft Sentinel tables (ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDhcpEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimUserManagementActivityLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs)
- A Data Collection Endpoint (DCE)
- A Microsoft Entra application with OAuth client credentials
- The Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment for that application on the DCR

No custom tables are created — events land in the built-in tables, so existing analytics rules, workbooks, and parsers continue to work unchanged.

properties.description: Detects when more than 5% of ASimAuditEventLogs records pushed by the VirtualMetric DataStream connector are missing one or more ASIM-mandatory fields (EventType, EventResult, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventStartTime, EventEndTime). A floor of 100 events per hour is applied to avoid noise on low-volume streams. Persistent drift indicates an agent-side mapping regression and should be investigated by the data engineering team.
properties.displayName: VirtualMetric DataStream - ASIM Audit schema drift
properties.query:
let DriftPct = 5.0;
let MinVolume = 100;
ASimAuditEventLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend Missing_EventType = isempty(EventType)
| extend Missing_EventResult = isempty(EventResult)
| extend Missing_EventVendor = isempty(EventVendor)
| extend Missing_EventProduct = isempty(EventProduct)
| extend Missing_EventStartTime = isnull(EventStartTime)
| extend Missing_EventEndTime = isnull(EventEndTime)
| extend HasMissingField = Missing_EventType or Missing_EventResult or Missing_EventVendor or Missing_EventProduct or Missing_EventStartTime or Missing_EventEndTime
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Drifted = countif(HasMissingField),
    MissingEventType = countif(Missing_EventType),
    MissingEventResult = countif(Missing_EventResult),
    MissingEventVendor = countif(Missing_EventVendor),
    MissingEventProduct = countif(Missing_EventProduct),
    MissingEventStartTime = countif(Missing_EventStartTime),
    MissingEventEndTime = countif(Missing_EventEndTime)
| extend DriftPercentage = round(100.0 * Drifted / Total, 2)
| extend Stream = "ASimAuditEventLogs"
| where Total >= MinVolume
| where DriftPercentage > DriftPct
| project Stream, Total, Drifted, DriftPercentage, MissingEventType, MissingEventResult, MissingEventVendor, MissingEventProduct, MissingEventStartTime, MissingEventEndTime

| extend DriftPercentage = round(100.0 * Drifted / Total, 2)
| extend Stream = "Syslog"
| where Total >= MinVolume
| where DriftPercentage > DriftPct
| project Stream, Total, Drifted, DriftPercentage, MissingComputer, MissingFacility, MissingSyslogMessage, MissingProcessName

properties.description: Detects when more than 5% of WindowsEvent records pushed by the VirtualMetric DataStream connector are missing one or more required fields (EventID, Computer, Channel, Provider). A floor of 100 events per hour is applied to avoid noise on low-volume streams. Persistent drift indicates an agent-side mapping regression and should be investigated by the data engineering team.
properties.query:
let DriftPct = 5.0;
let MinVolume = 100;
WindowsEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend Missing_EventID = isnull(EventID) or EventID == 0
| extend Missing_Computer = isempty(Computer)
| extend Missing_Channel = isempty(Channel)
| extend Missing_Provider = isempty(Provider)
| extend HasMissingField = Missing_EventID or Missing_Computer or Missing_Channel or Missing_Provider
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Drifted = countif(HasMissingField),
    MissingEventID = countif(Missing_EventID),
    MissingComputer = countif(Missing_Computer),
    MissingChannel = countif(Missing_Channel),
    MissingProvider = countif(Missing_Provider)
| extend DriftPercentage = round(100.0 * Drifted / Total, 2)
| extend Stream = "WindowsEvent"
| where Total >= MinVolume
| where DriftPercentage > DriftPct
| project Stream, Total, Drifted, DriftPercentage, MissingEventID, MissingComputer, MissingChannel, MissingProvider

properties.description: Detects streams pushed by the VirtualMetric DataStream connector that were active in the past 7 days but have received no events in the last hour. A historical floor of 100 events is applied to avoid alerting on streams that were never actually used. This usually indicates a DataStream agent outage, a credential expiry, or a network issue between the agent and the Data Collection Endpoint.
properties.query:
let SilenceWindow = 1h;
let MinHistoricalCount = 100;
let AllStreams = union withsource=Stream
    ASimAuditEventLogs,
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
    ASimDhcpEventLogs,
    ASimDnsActivityLogs,
    ASimFileEventLogs,
    ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
    ASimProcessEventLogs,
    ASimRegistryEventLogs,
    ASimUserManagementActivityLogs,
    ASimWebSessionLogs,
    CommonSecurityLog,
    Event,
    SecurityEvent,
    Syslog,
    WindowsEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d);
AllStreams
| summarize
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    HistoricalCount = count()
    by Stream
| where HistoricalCount >= MinHistoricalCount
| where LastSeen < ago(SilenceWindow)
| extend SilenceMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeen)
| project Stream, LastSeen, HistoricalCount, SilenceMinutes

properties.description: VMDataStreamVolumeSpike_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.1.1

Detects when a stream pushed by the VirtualMetric DataStream connector ingests more than 5x its 7-day hourly baseline in the last hour. A floor of 1000 events is applied to the recent window to avoid alerting on tiny streams whose ratios are inherently unstable. This catches misconfigured agents flooding the workspace, runaway debug logging, or an upstream system in an error loop - any of which can drive unexpected ingestion costs.
properties.query:
let SpikeMultiplier = 5.0;
let MinRecentVolume = 1000;
let AllStreams = union withsource=Stream
    ASimAuditEventLogs,
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
    ASimDhcpEventLogs,
    ASimDnsActivityLogs,
    ASimFileEventLogs,
    ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
    ASimProcessEventLogs,
    ASimRegistryEventLogs,
    ASimUserManagementActivityLogs,
    ASimWebSessionLogs,
    CommonSecurityLog,
    Event,
    SecurityEvent,
    Syslog,
    WindowsEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d);
let RecentCounts = AllStreams
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | summarize RecentCount = count() by Stream;
let BaselineCounts = AllStreams
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(7d) .. ago(1h))
    | summarize Count = count() by Stream, Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | summarize BaselineAvg = avg(Count), BaselineStdev = stdev(Count) by Stream;
RecentCounts
| join kind=inner BaselineCounts on Stream
| extend SpikeRatio = todouble(RecentCount) / BaselineAvg
| where RecentCount > MinRecentVolume
| where SpikeRatio > SpikeMultiplier
| project Stream, RecentCount, BaselineAvg = round(BaselineAvg, 1), BaselineStdev = round(BaselineStdev, 1), SpikeRatio = round(SpikeRatio, 2)

properties.description: Detects when the P95 gap between an event's TimeGenerated and its ingestion_time() exceeds 30 minutes for a stream pushed by the VirtualMetric DataStream connector. A floor of 100 sample events per hour is applied. Persistent latency means the DataStream agent is buffering, throttled, or facing backpressure, and detections built on these tables will run against stale data.
properties.query:
let LatencyThresholdMin = 30;
let MinSamples = 100;
let AllStreams = union withsource=Stream
    ASimAuditEventLogs,
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
    ASimDhcpEventLogs,
    ASimDnsActivityLogs,
    ASimFileEventLogs,
    ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
    ASimProcessEventLogs,
    ASimRegistryEventLogs,
    ASimUserManagementActivityLogs,
    ASimWebSessionLogs,
    CommonSecurityLog,
    Event,
    SecurityEvent,
    Syslog,
    WindowsEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h);
AllStreams
| extend IngestionLatencyMin = abs(datetime_diff('second', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated)) / 60.0
| summarize
    SampleCount = count(),
    AvgLatencyMin = avg(IngestionLatencyMin),
    P95LatencyMin = percentile(IngestionLatencyMin, 95),
    MaxLatencyMin = max(IngestionLatencyMin)
    by Stream
| where SampleCount >= MinSamples
| where P95LatencyMin > LatencyThresholdMin
| project Stream, SampleCount, AvgLatencyMin = round(AvgLatencyMin, 1), P95LatencyMin = round(P95LatencyMin, 1), MaxLatencyMin = round(MaxLatencyMin, 1)

Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The VirtualMetric DataStream Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push solution lets the VirtualMetric DataStream agent push security and ASIM-normalized telemetry directly to Microsoft Sentinel. Two tiles let you selectively enable Standard streams (CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, Event, Syslog, WindowsEvent) or ASIM-normalized streams (Audit, Authentication, Dhcp, Dns, File, NetworkSession, Process, Registry, UserManagement, WebSession). Both tiles share a single Data Collection Endpoint per workspace. Authentication, DCR provisioning, Entra app, and required role assignments are automated when each tile's Deploy button is clicked.

Data Connectors: 2, Analytic Rules: 18
